description:
Docs/repo-meta batch in /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid (no daemon.js or lib logic changes EXCEPT the frontier.js comment text):

1. README tool surface: README.md lists only ~7 MCP tools; lib/mcp-core.js TOOLS array is the live registry (~29-31 tools). Regenerate the README tool section from the actual TOOLS array — group by purpose (task lifecycle, graph read, knowledge/notes, judge/KB, loop/agent control), one line each from the tool's description (first sentence). Also document `npm run test:all` and the CI workflow where README covers development.
2. CONTRIBUTING.md: add a Testing section — how to run a single test file, `npm test` (fast regression) vs `npm run test:all` (full suite, 49 files), the sandboxed-daemon convention for tests that need a daemon (private port + tmp CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, never the live 8787), and that CI runs test:all with --omit=optional under ZONOID_SKIP_LIVE=1.
3. .graph merge strategy: .graph/ is INTENTIONALLY git-versioned, but attempt-branch worktrees can diverge it and merge_attempt would hit delete/modify + checkpoint.json conflicts. Add a .gitattributes entry `.graph/** merge=ours` and document in CONTRIBUTING that this requires the one-time driver config `git config merge.ours.driver true` (gitattributes merge drivers are not auto-portable across clones — document it clearly, including WHY: the daemon is the source of truth for graph state; on merge, keep the current branch's .graph wholesale).
4. lib/frontier.js stale comments: the hop-weight threshold multiplier in code is 0.30 (line ~56) but comments at lines ~5, ~33, ~46, ~58 still say 0.25. Fix the comment text ONLY — do not touch code.

Verify: `node --check lib/frontier.js`, render-check the README section (consistent formatting), and confirm .gitattributes syntax with `git check-attr merge .graph/nodes/x.jsonl`. Do NOT git commit; leave changes in the working tree.

CAUTION: uncommitted sibling work throughout the tree — minimal diffs, never revert anything.
